title: Schematify design is owned; automation-written files are not
context: Schematify has semantic design files (human-authored) and automation files (CI writes runs/, node drag rewrites layout/). CODEOWNERS needs to reflect this split.
decision: The Schematify design files (`nodes/`, `edges/`, `rules/`, `screens/`, `flows/`, `decisions/`, `registry/`, `brief.json`) are owned by the maintainer. The automation-written trees (`runs/`, `layout/`) have no owner because CI and node drag write them. Assigning a human owner to trees only automation touches would make every routine write wait on a review it does not need.
consequences: Some files carry no CODEOWNERS entry by design. Machines can write to `runs/` and `layout/` without review. Semantic design changes still require owner approval. The lifecycle pair is the one exception: `nodes/` carries the owner (human-triggered transition), `runs/` does not (CI-written).
